Found it. Line 3 uses `<=` which iterates one step too far — when `i === values.length`, `values[i]` is `undefined`, making the total `NaN`.Tests pass, but the verify command uses `npx vitest run` without `--globals`. I need to add a vitest config so `describe`/`it`/`expect` are available globally.Fixed. The off-by-one was in `src/utils.ts` line 3: `i <= values.length` iterated one step past the array end, accessing `values[values.length]` which is `undefined` and poisons the sum with `NaN`.

**Change:** `i <= values.length` → `i < values.length`

Also added `vitest.config.ts` so the verify command `npx vitest run` picks up `globals: true` (the test file uses `describe`/`it`/`expect` without importing them). Tests now pass cleanly.
